newsitem.title: USA: Fed says overnight system totals $7.649 billion.
newsitem.headline: Fed says overnight system totals $7.649 billion.

text.p: The Federal Reserve's temporary addition of reserves via overnight system repurchase agreements totaled $7.649 billion on Thursday, a Fed spokeswoman said.

Detailing the size of its system repurchase agreements operation is part of the Fed's new daily open market operations announced late last year. The Fed revamped its daily intervention procedure to keep pace with stepped-up market activity.
At 1120 EST/1620 GMT, the overnight bank lending, or federal funds rate, stood significantly above the Fed's 5-1/4-percent target for the rate at 5-3/4 percent.
On Tuesday, funds closed at 5.00 percent.
